description: Is there a winner yet in a price test? Send the trials and conversions of two to ten variants and get, for each, its chance of being best, its expected loss and a 95% credible interval, and a verdict of winner, equivalent or continue. With exactly two variants, the first is the control and a sequential probability ratio test is added. Change the prior, win_probability, loss_threshold or sprt settings to be stricter or looser. Billed as one call to the significance function. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

loss_threshold.description: Expected loss under which a variant is good enough.

prior.description: Beta prior on the conversion rate. Defaults to a flat prior.

sprt.description: Sequential test settings for two variants.

variants.description: Two to ten variants, each with a unique id, its trials and its conversions (never more than trials).

id.description: A name for the variant, unique in the list.

trials.description: How many times it was shown.

win_probability.description: Chance of being best needed to call a winner.

name: check_variant_significance
